consequence.statement: From Kafka 4.0.0, the JMXReporter is only enabled if metrics are explicitly configured in spec.kafka.metrics or JMXReporter is explicitly added to metric.reporters; previously it may have been enabled differently or by default.

assertion.statement: From Kafka 4.0.0, enabling the JMXReporter requires explicit configuration either in spec.kafka.metrics or by adding JMXReporter to metric.reporters.
